policy: An implementation or local focused pass is not a current-commit release certificate. Closure requires accepted evidence for the exact delivered source.

issues.problem: Aggregate boundaries require portable physical carriers
issues.implementation: Native aggregate values are normalized to typed pointer/output channels; actual Browser Mono/AOT invocation remains a required remote gate.

issues.problem: Managed runtime and call ABI implementations belong outside the Engine
issues.implementation: Engine consumes independent runtime and ABI ports; optional execution implementations are explicitly registered.

issues.problem: Target SDK rules are implementation responsibilities
issues.implementation: Desktop discovery and optional target implementations live under extensions; no consumer build providers exist.

issues.problem: Host path semantics and frontend argument interpretation are explicit
issues.implementation: Injected host path identities and independently prepared frontend inputs are verified before publication.
General dispatcher interfaces remain; runtime-specific automatic Browser dispatch selection is removed.

issues.problem: C lowering must participate in the actual generation flow
issues.implementation: Typed C lowering is emitted and reparsed, with native consumer tests outside the product.

issues.problem: Source contribution and post-parse lowering are separate stages
issues.implementation: Original source contribution runs before the first parse; bridge verification does not repeat it.

issues.problem: C and C++ share the formal bridge model
issues.implementation: Common bridge settings and ports replace C++-only authoring contracts; language-specific behavior stays explicit.

issues.problem: Runtime and call ABI require their own extension ports
issues.implementation: Independent providers and exact profile-bound call plans do not infer support from target names.

issues.problem: Generation, cleanup and publication ordering must be reviewable
issues.implementation: Generation services close before commit; host infrastructure survives final input fences and publication; committed cleanup failure is represented accurately.

issues.problem: The affected Browser path needs actual invocation evidence
issues.implementation: A fixed Mono Wasm/AOT aggregate and callback regression executes once in Linux smoke; not yet certified by source presence.

issues.problem: Frontend tests must use public contracts
issues.implementation: No friend assembly or private behavior reflection is retained; original fact cases map to public frontend results.

issues.problem: Documentation and installed examples must match the current product
issues.implementation: Current documentation uses Core, schema2 and4.1.1; installation examples still require actual accepted packages.

issues.problem: SDK declarations and installation locks must agree
issues.implementation: SDK10.0.402/latestPatch/no previews and exact isolated runtime/resource hashes are synchronized.

issues.problem: Anonymous type diagnostic spellings reached native assertions and injected field offsets were estimated
issues.owner: Frontend declaration facts, shared native type formatting and native storage assertions
issues.implementation: Preserve declaration/alias identity, real compiler field offsets and recursive structural member proofs without platform-specific exceptions. Native model revision4 rejects stale cache facts.

outsideProduct: Library-specific ownership declarations and facade design
Consumer compilation, linking, packaging, deployment and package updates
retainedRegressions: Portable logical input roots and relocated generated source
Shared dependent-template type references preserve declaration ownership
